At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together! Engineer II Software Development – Platform Experience Team Description Join the Platform Experience team, a core group within our GPTO Engineering organization, where you will report to the Director of Engineering. Our team is on a mission to provide the unshakeable foundation of trust, security, and scale for the entire Anaplan ecosystem. We empower our internal developers and external partners to build with speed and confidence. Your Impact Contribute significantly to the design and execution of our Platform Experience, playing a vital role across Product Security, Platform Management, and Data Integration initiatives. Design, build, and maintain the highly available , secure, and scalable services that form the backbone of our platform. Champion engineering excellence through high-quality, hands-on coding, collaborative design reviews, and mentorship of junior engineers on our backend technology stack (Java, Kotlin, Go, .NET). Actively participate in technical planning, contribute to our team's strategy, and engage in critical incident retrospectives to foster a culture of continuous improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers and other engineering groups, to deliver robust and reliable platform solutions. Your Qualifications A strong seniority in full-stack web development ideally using Frontend technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, Redux and Backend such as Java, Kotlin, Spring Framework, MySQL Proficiency in using REST APIs or similar for data integration. Experience working in production with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, GCP or Azure. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Helm Experience with building observability into services to track usage and health (Grafana stack) A deep understanding of the value of testing to deliver a high-quality product. Working knowledge of containers and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Experience working closely with product management and UX teams to deliver the best solution to the problem at hand. A strong background in fostering a culture of continuous delivery, test automation and agile development. Experience in ExpressJS/Next.js, Webpack, WebSocket, Gulp are a plus Strong communication and collaboration skills - you are pragmatic and know how to build trust. BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Skills Experience with private and public cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure). Proven ability to influence your team's technical decisions and lead projects to completion. A passion for mentoring other engineers and elevating the team's capabilities. Experience with CI/CD best practices , infrastructure-as-code tools (like Terraform). Experience - 6- 12 Years We know that great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification on this list. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. Anaplan does not: Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. AI ENGINEERING REQUIREMENTS High proficiency using AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) with a strong understanding of AI-driven and AI-managed coding workflows. Solid grounding in prompt engineering — structuring, iterating, and validating prompts for consistent, production-quality code generation. Hands-on experience designing and constructing AI coding agent customisations: agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and plugins. CORE SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Frontend React / Angular (micro-frontend architecture with single-spa / Module Federation) TypeScript, HTML5, CSS Unit testing: Jasmine, Karma, Jest Backend & Integration Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud) — primary backend services Node.js — lightweight APIs and integration services RESTful APIs & microservices architecture KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, build, and deliver end-to-end features across React/Angular frontends and Java/Node.js microservices, integrated with REST APIs and Kafka-based event streams. Maintain observability standards — structured logging (ELK/Datadog), alerting (Prometheus/Grafana/AppDynamics), and performance profiling. Collaborate with product, design, and architecture teams to translate business goals into scalable, compliant technical solutions. Manage parallel workstreams and evolving requirements, ensuring incremental and continuous value delivery through agile practices. Join now By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement , Privacy Policy , and Cookie Policy . Who we are DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com Job summary We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience and strong full-stack expertise in Java backend development and React frontend engineering. The ideal candidate will independently design, develop, and own scalable, secure, and reliable applications across the full technology stack. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, React, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies. Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML, along with Okta or similar identity providers, is highly desirable. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, system design capability, production ownership, and the ability to make sound technical decisions. The engineer will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Security, and Engineering teams, contribute to architecture and technical direction, and mentor other engineers. Experience with event-driven architectures, observability, and AI/LLM integration is a strong plus. What you will do Design, develop, and maintain Java/Spring Boot services and RESTful APIs, taking end-to-end ownership of features and services. Design and implement scalable, reliable, and secure microservices and distributed systems. Make technical design decisions considering scalability, availability, performance, security, and maintainability. Build and maintain React applications and reusable UI components, following best practices for state management, routing, accessibility, and frontend performance. Design and implement authentication and authorization flows using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML, including integrations with Okta or other identity providers. Apply security best practices including secure token handling, RBAC, input validation, secrets management, and secure API design. Take ownership of features through the complete lifecycle — requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools. Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, with experience in Helm and/or Terraform. Monitor and troubleshoot production applications using observability tools such as New Relic, Splunk, or Datadog. Participate in incident response, perform root-cause analysis, and drive preventive and corrective actions. Write comprehensive unit, integration, and API tests and continuously improve code quality and test coverage. Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews, providing technical guidance and constructive feedback. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to improving engineering practices across the team. Collaborate with Product, Design, Security, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Create and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, architecture decisions, and operational runbooks. Identify and drive opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. Evaluate and integrate AI/LLM capabilities into product features where appropriate, including LLM APIs, RAG-based solutions, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. What you will have 6+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on full-stack development experience. Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and microservices architecture. Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, hooks, component design, and state management. Solid understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML. Experience with Okta, Azure AD, or similar identity providers is highly desirable. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and software architecture. Experience designing and developing applications for scalability, availability, reliability, performance, and security. Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, SQL optimization, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Helm and/or Terraform and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with production troubleshooting, observability, monitoring, and incident management. Strong understanding of automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Ability to independently own complex features and make effective technical decisions with minimal supervision. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and other cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction. Nice to have Experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, digital certificates, or PKI. Experience with Kafka or other event-driven/event-streaming architectures. Experience designing and operating highly available distributed systems at scale. Familiarity with feature flags, blue/green deployments, canary releases, or progressive delivery strategies. Experience building AI-powered product capabilities using LLM APIs, RAG, prompt engineering, or generative AI. Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into Java and/or React applications. Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives or architecture improvements. Contributions to engineering standards, technical strategy, or developer productivity initiatives. Experience leading technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams. Benefits Generous time off policies Top shelf benefits Education, wellness and lifestyle support To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered. Company Description It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here. Job Description Primary Function Intuitive is building a new AI-powered platform to support how our teams work day to day — combining a modern web application, cloud-native backend services, and generative AI to make information easier to find, questions easier to answer, and repetitive work easier to automate. We're looking for a mid-level full-stack engineer who can take ownership of features end-to-end, contribute to architectural decisions with guidance, and collaborate closely with business teams to ship real, production-grade software. You're past the basics and ready to take on meaningful scope — while still growing into senior-level independence. Roles And Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain both the frontend and backend of a new internal platform, from feature development through production Build and maintain integrations between the platform and its underlying cloud and AI infrastructure Partner with business teams to translate day-to-day workflows into working software, with some guidance from senior engineers Implement secure authentication, access control, and data governance appropriate for sensitive business data Contribute to and follow engineering best practices — testing, CI/CD, deployment, and observability Iterate on features based on real usage and feedback, balancing speed with reliability Qualifications Skill/Job Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to both frontend and backend systems Solid Python skills; experience with FastAPI or a comparable async Python web framework Solid React + TypeScript experience — shipped features in a production environment Familiarity with LLM/AI API integrations — agentic or tool-calling patterns are a plus Experience with a major cloud provider (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP considered) — comfortable deploying and managing cloud resources Strong foundational knowledge of SQL query writing with a proven ability to understand and optimize database performance. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authentication flows Ability to work with non-technical business stakeholders to clarify and shape requirements Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments Additional Information Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR 743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the Candidate’s Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.
